entries.wording: Delivered to your community mailbox, parcel locker or apt./condo mailbox
Crossing border and in transit to carrier hub
Shipment received at originating postal facility

entries.note: The parcel leaving one of the network's facilities, the counterpart of its incoming scan.

entries.wording: Delivered - Delivery / deposit with non-recurring authority
Item arrival at collection point for pick-up
entries.note: A destination post's UPU wording for a parcel waiting at its counter.
A delivery partner's hub after Landmark exported the parcel, not its acceptance.
Evri's hub after Landmark exported the parcel, not its acceptance.
Evri's depot hands the parcel to its courier, who confirms receipt before the delivery round.

entries.wording: Item deposited to local postal operator
entries.note: Landmark hands the parcel to the destination's postal operator for the last mile, as a provider relayed it. Not a delivery.
A scan at a carrier's facility, seen after Landmark's processing; read as its other facility scans are.

entries.wording: Grouped when pallet scanned to crossing (… #…)
entries.note: At Landmark's hub the parcel joins a pallet for the crossing to the destination country, before customs and the crossing scans. The row names the crossing and the pallet's number, read as "…": "(DDU #1234)", "(SLC INTERPOST #1)", or a crossing named by a word and its duty terms, "(EXAMPLE DDP #77)".
The export from the sending country's office of exchange, after the crossing scans.
The arrival in the destination country, days after the departure to it, at the minute of the destination post's own row saying the same.

entries.wording: Data upload, shipments not yet arrived at HUB
entries.note: The parcel's data alone, at the minute of the upload, before Landmark's processing; the shared rules would read its "arrived" as transit.
Landmark's facility grouping the parcel, days after its processing and before its outgoing scan.
The delivery partner's hub, at the minute of the partner's own receipt.
The delivery partner's depot, before its round.
A facility's arrival in bpost's words, a day after the depot's departure and two before the outgoing scan.

entries.wording: Out for delivery - First Delivery Attempt
entries.note: The partner's first round, at the minute of its own out-for-delivery row; a failure is a later row. The shared rules would read "Delivery Attempt" as a failed attempt.
